title: Nuclear Engineering, B.S. (College of Engineering)
notes: Pre-2024-25 curriculum, built from the archived 2022-23 bulletin's Suggested Academic Plan and Program Requirements tabs (fetched directly; confirmed byte-identical to 2023-24, see NUCE-2023.json's own notes). This year's real curriculum uses Mechanical Engineering support courses -- ME 300 (Engineering Thermodynamics I), ME 320 (Fluid Flow), ME 410 (Heat Transfer) -- instead of the in-house NUCE 321/NUCE 322 thermal-fluids sequence that replaced them starting with the 2024-25 curriculum overhaul (compare NUCE-2024.json / current NUCE-2026.json). Real difference: NUCE 420 (Radiological Safety) was one of the 'Select 6 credits...' Nuclear Engineering elective options this year, not a required core course -- it only became a required core course starting 2024-25, so it stays in this year's elective match set. Real difference: NUCE 297 did not yet exist as this program's First-Year Seminar course -- the bulletin lists a generic, code-less 'First Year Seminar' (1 credit), modeled as an unenforced slot the same way CMPSC-2022.json models its own equivalent. The bulletin's own 'Select 6 credits, of which 3 credits must be designated as design' Nuclear Engineering elective list for this year reads: BME 406, NUCE 405, NUCE 408, NUCE 409, NUCE 420, NUCE 428, NUCE 470, NUCE 490, NUCE 496, NUCE 497, or 500-level NUCE courses with adviser approval. BME 406 (a different department, not in this plan's own department list), NUCE 470, the 496/497 independent-study/special-topics codes, and open-ended '500-level with approval' aren't concretely modeled, same 'generic, unenforced open pool' convention used throughout this codebase (e.g. CMPSC's own Department List electives before they were wired to a real denylist) -- the match regex instead follows the same real, year-independent department course-numbering policy NUCE-2026.json already relies on (400-level NUCE courses except 401, this year's own required core, and the 490/494/496/497/499 independent-study/special-topics codes), with NUCE 420 included since it wasn't required core yet: NUCE 405/406/408/409/420/428/441/442/480. Same real CHEM 110 -> MATH 22 -> MATH 21 -> MATH 4 -> MATH 3 prerequisite-chain gap as NUCE-2026.json -- this is a year-independent university course-catalog fact (CHEM 110's real prereq), not a 2026-curriculum-specific one, so MATH 3/4/21/22 are added the same way across Semesters 1-4. EMCH 316 (needs EMCH 315 as a strict prior-term prerequisite, not concurrent) is scheduled the same term as EMCH 315 in this year's own bulletin Suggested Academic Plan too (Third Year Spring) -- moved to the following term (Fourth Year Fall) for the same real reason as NUCE-2026.json, with both Nuclear Engineering elective slots consolidated into the final semester (Spring, Fourth Year) to make room for it, mirroring NUCE-2026.json's own resequencing. max_credits_per_semester raised to 19, same as NUCE-2026.json, to fit the added prereq-chain courses without spilling into a 9th term while still keeping every real Gen Ed credit from the bulletin's own Suggested Academic Plan (none dropped). 'Nuclear Engineering elective' and 'General Technical Elective' pools are otherwise modeled generically, same convention as the 2026 plan and CMPSC's own open pools.
